shortDescription: The Singapore government said it will not interfere in any decision Singapore Airlines Ltd. makes regarding Air India Ltd., according to Bloomberg.Air India is said to be seeking financial aid from its shareholders.

title: Singapore Says It Won’t Interfere in Singapore Airlines’ Air India Decisions
